key_facts: On November 1, 2024 at approximately 12:54 a.m., CHP Officers Santiago Meza-Gonzalez (#023295) and Jose Melano (#023054) contacted Plaintiff on the eastbound I-580 dirt shoulder near Isabel Avenue, Livermore (CHP Case No. RJ68845; CAD No. 241101GG0064). This matter is the portfolio document home for that encounter: the DS-367 / Arrest Report / dashcam transcript / DMV discovery set at the matter-32 root, plus every PDF filing from the five live CHP-cluster dockets (Matters 1, 2, 7, 20, and 24) stored under from-01 through from-24. Operative litigation captions and case numbers remain on those source matters; Matter 32 consolidates the PDF store under the Ngwa Nforbi v. Meza-Gonzalez caption.
procedural_status: Opened August 7, 2026 as Matter 32. Initially received the shared November 1, 2024 CHP incident PDFs (formerly documents/_shared/chp-nov1-2024/). Same day, all PDFs from Matters 1 (federal CHP §1983), 2 (Alameda Meza-Gonzalez tort — stayed), 7 (Candelaria federal), 20 (Alameda CHP writ / U-visa), and 24 (Serrato N.D. Cal.) were relocated into documents/matter-32/from-01|02|07|20|24/. Non-PDF working files (.docx) remain in their original matter folders. Matters 1, 2, 7, 20, and 24 remain live docket records and cross-reference the relocated paths; Matter 32 is the owning folder. On August 7, 2026 a Complaint for Damages under 42 U.S.C. § 1983 was drafted under the Ngwa Nforbi v. Meza-Gonzalez caption for the Northern District of California, together with the supporting intake packet: JS 44 civil cover sheet (nature of suit 440, federal question, jury demand, related case 4:26-cv-05953-ASK), AO 440 summonses for Meza-Gonzalez (service at CHP Modesto Area, 4030 Kiernan Ave.) and Melano (service at CHP South Sacramento Area, 6 Massie Ct.), and a Consent to Magistrate Judge Jurisdiction form. Each summons is addressed to the officer's current duty station, which is no longer the CHP Dublin Area pleaded at Compl. ¶¶ 13-14. Nothing has been filed: no case number has issued, the civil action number and clerk signature blocks on both summonses are blank, and the consent form's case-number field is blank pending assignment (due within 14 days of case initiation).
damages: None separately demanded under this caption. Operative damages remain those pleaded in Matters 1, 2, 7, 20, and 24. Matter 32 is documentary ownership of the CHP-cluster PDF set.
risk: Caption confusion with Matter 2 remains the principal risk — the same November 1, 2024 encounter is pleaded there as state torts against Meza-Gonzalez under the Newanforbi name form, and Matter 2 is stayed pending the Matter 1 district-judge ruling; filing this federal action while Matters 1 and 2 are live invites claim-splitting and issue-preclusion arguments from the AG. Do not plead overlapping damages under Matter 32. Both officers have transferred out of the CHP Dublin Area since November 1, 2024, so the summonses go to Modesto and South Sacramento while Compl. ¶¶ 13-14 still describe the Dublin assignment in the present tense — conform those paragraphs before filing. If filed, a Civil L.R. 3-12 administrative motion to consider whether the case is related to 4:26-cv-05953-ASK should accompany it. Source-matter scripts that write into documents/matter-20/ (SER-001 / sheriff packets) must target documents/matter-32/from-20/ going forward.
